About.metaDescription: The Kurdish Heritage Institute — preserving, researching, and sharing Kurdish cultural heritage.

mission.p1: The Kurdish Heritage Institute was founded in 2003 by the artist Mazhər Xalqî. From our main bases in Sulaymaniyah and Duhok, we work as a scientific centre to preserve the oral culture and national identity of all communities across Kurdistan. Our task is to collect and safeguard the rich heritage passed down from our ancestors, establishing it through scholarly research as a trusted source.
mission.p2: We firmly believe that culture is not merely a return to the past, but a foundation for building the future. That is why we do not stop at archiving alone — we use modern technology and publish scholarly work to revive national consciousness and carry it to coming generations.
mission.p3: The institute's work spans the library and audiovisual archive to production studios and the printing house. Each year we carry out our own projects in research, publishing, and artistic production. We also supervise and guide collaborative scholarly efforts with researchers and institutions working for Kurdish culture.

Services.metaDescription: Services of the Kurdish Heritage Institute — hall, studio, research, printing, sales, library, and archive.

hero.title: Our Services
hero.intro: We have created a scientific and artistic environment so that researchers and creators can bring their projects to fruition through the institute's departments; our services are an effort to turn your ideas into worthy work.

institute-hall.title: Institute Hall
institute-hall.body: This hall accommodates 300 people and is equipped with professional sound and lighting engineering so audiences receive the best audio and visuals. The hall is arranged for film screenings, concerts, theatre, and other events; through a dedicated control room, artistic work can also be recorded professionally.

studio.title: Studio
studio.body: Two recording studios are equipped with the highest-quality digital and analogue gear, along with specialised microphones for different fields. Technical detail is prioritised here to achieve the highest standard in recording music, dubbing, and film sound.

research-publishing.title: Research & Publishing
research-publishing.body: A scientific platform dedicated to refining projects and research that serve our people's language, history, and cultural identity. All submitted material is reviewed by a qualified committee so that content and quality meet scientific standards.

printing-house.title: Printing House
printing-house.body: Using suitable materials and advanced printing equipment ensures the longevity of publications. Printing here is not merely a stage but the completion of the research process — after review, a sample print is made available.

sales.title: Sales
sales.body: Our publications are available at both Sulaymaniyah and Duhok centres. Work is underway on an advanced system so that in the future ordering, purchasing, and delivery can be done quickly and conveniently through our website.

library.title: Library
library.body: Our library is a rich resource in history, lexicography, and the heritage of our people. The library environment is arranged to be a calm place for students and researchers, with thousands of rare sources available.

audio-visual-archive.title: Audio & Visual Archive
audio-visual-archive.body: Our archive is a treasury of Kurdish audio and visual material. Students and researchers can draw on this rich archive for any project or creation that serves Kurdish culture.

joint-projects.title: Joint Projects
joint-projects.body: This is a centre for developing projects devoted to preserving Kurdish heritage. Those who hold rare archives and documents can here turn their work into scientific and artistic output of world-class quality.
